'''Ray Chase''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Chase was born on May 20, 1987. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Chase joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he voiced recurring character [[Professor Cerise]].
